reasoning: This commit introduced the `filesFromThisSite` Set used to track which files belong to the currently-processed update site, and used it to decide whether to override existing files (shadowing logic). However, it never cleared this set at the start of processing each new update site's read() call, so state from a previous update site persisted and blocked shadowing/overriding files in later reads. The fix commit simply adds `filesFromThisSite.clear();` at the start of `read()`, directly correcting the omission introduced when this field and its usage were first added.
